purpose: Frozen CPU baseline for the DiskJoin minimal reproduction: source + patch chain, toolchain, binaries, data, graph, tasks, config, CPU binding, and GT/eval protocol for the original implementation (1-thread), the optimized C path (1-thread), and the optimized C path (4-thread).

frozen_source.note: The instrumented copy carries env-gated, additive experiment gates only; unset gates reproduce the reference behaviour. Patch files (unified diffs) below are the auditable chain.

patch_chain.description: Output-only per-thread streaming pair sink (GATE15_PER_THREAD_STREAM). Writes each compute thread's pairs to GATE3_PAIR_OUT.t<tid>; compute logic (candidates, ordering, pruning, threshold, distance, counters) unchanged.

compiler_and_options.build_type: Release (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release; CMakeCache CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE is empty, flags set explicitly)
compiler_and_options.openmp: enabled (-fopenmp); no num_threads clause and no omp_set_num_threads anywhere -> OMP_NUM_THREADS governs both build and compute
compiler_and_options.simd_kernel: utils::L2Sqr -> L2SqrSIMD -> L2SqrFloatAVX512 (AVX-512F zmm FMA; 192 zmm instructions in the step14 binary). USE_AVX512 is selected from __AVX512F__ supplied by -march=native.
compiler_and_options.note: dist_l2 is a mutable global function pointer -> indirect, out-of-line call per distance.

original_impl_1thread.gates: no C-path gate; original point-point loops

bigann1m_fixed.identity: byte-identical to the step10 phase2 graph used by step10/step11

tasks.note: Task order is derived from the fixed graph (Gorder); with GATE14_SKIP_BUILD it is identical across thread counts.

cpu_topology_and_binding.topology: 24 logical = 12 physical cores x 2 SMT, single socket, single NUMA node (0-23). Physical core K = {K, K+12}.
cpu_topology_and_binding.omp_env: OMP_PROC_BIND=true OMP_PLACES=cores (OMP_DISPLAY_AFFINITY=TRUE recorded in stderr). Nested physical cores only; no SMT siblings in use.

sampled_recall.formula: recall = count / config.gt, where `count` is incremented once per hit whose vector id is divisible by 100000 (and once more if the other id is too)
sampled_recall.scope: SAMPLED recall under this ID-divisibility convention only. It is NOT a full-join recall and is NOT a GT-enumerated recall.

full_output_consistency.method: exact pair MULTISET equality of the complete emitted pair list. Each pair file is sorted (LC_ALL=C) and the sorted byte stream is hashed (sha256); equality of the full sorted stream + equal N is exact multiset equality (no count/XOR/sum surrogate).
full_output_consistency.scope: Complete-output consistency for the fixed config. It establishes that the multiset of emitted pairs is unchanged; it does NOT establish full-join recall and does NOT use GT beyond the count above.

configurations.build_note: graph/tasks built in-run by this binary

configurations.impl: GATE13_C_PATH=1 (blocked fixed-128, register-reuse, inline AVX-512 kernel)
configurations.build_note: step13 built the graph 1-thread; step13 A-vs-C comparison builds in both
REUSES the fixed step13 graph/tasks (GATE14_SKIP_BUILD=1) because the build is not deterministic across thread counts; step14 records the build separately

1m_multiset_4thread_vs_1thread_step7_ref.build: 4-thread run reuses fixed graph; step7 reference INCLUDED its own build

1m_A_vs_B_byte_identical_pairs.build: both included build (own graphs, byte-identical hashes)

evidence_scopes.sampled_recall: Sampled only (IDs divisible by 100000), gt convention as above. Separate from full-output consistency.
evidence_scopes.full_output_consistency: Complete pair multiset equality vs the frozen reference for the fixed config. Does not imply GT recall.
evidence_scopes.perf_timings: Wall/CPU phase timings (GATE5B_PROFILE) and /usr/bin/time -v; perf(1) unavailable (perf_event_paranoid=4).
evidence_scopes.cpu_scaling: Step14: compute wall 246.84 -> 123.15 -> 63.47 s (2.004x / 3.889x), search 255.65 -> 131.48 -> 71.76 s. Amdahl-limited by ~8.1 s serial preload. This is a 4-physical-core CPU scaling result, NOT a GPU claim.

normal_runs.step15_1m_4thread_error_strings: none (grep for error/sanitizer/abort/segfault matched only the config key 'error_bound')
normal_runs.note: Exact multiset match and exact-counter invariance are themselves the strongest checks: any logic change would alter the pair multiset.

sanitizer_runs.scope: step13 (separate from the step15 normal run)
sanitizer_runs.asan_ubsan_100k_result: CMP=IDENTICAL to the non-sanitizer 100K output; sanitizer-clean
sanitizer_runs.note: The 1M step15 run was a normal (non-sanitizer) build; it is NOT an ASan run.

resource_envelope.note: The default buffered sink would need 398737742 x 16 B = 6.38 GB RSS (> 2 GiB), which is why the output-only per-thread streaming sink (GATE15) exists.

wording_constraints: Step11's 'distance computation dominates' is supported only as a TIME share of the compute phase (96.83% of search); it is not a claim about the distance kernel alone.

Do not state a 'unique bottleneck' or that 'load balance is proven'. Step14 measured near-linear scaling within 4 physical cores and an Amdahl limit from the serial preload; it did not prove per-thread load balance or sole-bottleneck status.
Sampled Recall and full-output consistency are separate evidence scopes; neither is a full-join recall.
Normal-run no-error and sanitizer verification are recorded separately; the 1M run is not a sanitizer run.
This baseline is CPU-only; no GPU claim is made or implied.
